finding.summary: readMultipleFiles counts only successful content blocks toward its 262144-byte cap; summary text, error summaries and summary newlines are uncounted.

proposed_contract: Sum Buffer.byteLength(text, utf8) for every returned text content item, including all joined summary lines and separators. Inclusive cap 262144.
Retain one summary item first followed by successful text items in input order; duplicate paths remain repeated, per-file safe errors stay summaries.
Any aggregate overflow rejects the whole tool operation with stable RESPONSE_LIMIT. Do not truncate file text or silently omit data.
Preserve existing 1..20 path schema, nonempty path max4096 UTF16 code units, FileService root/private/link policy and configured file ceilings.
Keep total text cap distinct from unchanged 524288 serialized result wire cap in src/mcp.ts.
Use checked append after read outcome or equivalently explicit summary+block counters; a limit error must never be converted to an ordinary per-file summary.
Do not read subsequent paths after budget exhaustion; preserve cancellation at pre-read and post-await boundaries.
test_recommendations: Literal expected response for mixed success/ENOENT/private/outside/unsupported, correct input order and successful items order.
Single-file total text bytes exactly262144 accepted, one byte more rejected even though file and block separately fit old limits.
UTF8 multibyte contents and path names counted in bytes; no truncation or replacement character introduced.
Near-limit success followed by missing/private summary exceeds aggregate and is rejected.
Multiple successes and summary separator bytes across exact boundary; duplicates are counted per occurrence.
All errors produce summary-only response, raw OS/unknown error text never appears.
Empty/21-path/invalid path schema errors; pre-cancel and abort during read do not continue to subsequent path.
Real packed installed MCP exact boundary/error envelope and read-only tool exposure, independently observed npm launcher/server exits and owned-fixture cleanup.
acceptance_limits: No full DCP-019 acceptance: image/Office/format contracts remain unsupported.
SDK-invoked installed or Codex-parsed commands do not prove model-driven Codex or actual ChatGPT invocation.
No claim of OS sandbox or universal cancellation interleavings.
mutations: Only this task-scoped review file; no source, Windows, GitHub, enrollment or config mutation.
